observations: White game console with a vertical split design, characteristic of the PlayStation 5 Slim model.
One photo shows the console in a vertical orientation, while the other shows it in a horizontal orientation.
A white DualSense wireless controller is visible in both photos.
The console has a glossy finish with visible reflections.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI ABIODUN JAMES' is present on both images.
The background shows a framed picture of a music player interface.

claims.evidence: The glossy surface shows reflections and the console is shown from angles that do not allow for a full inspection of the rear and bottom panels.
The vertical split design is the defining feature of the PS5 Slim model.
A white DualSense controller is shown in both photos.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a faulty HDMI port.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen and a clear image on an external screen.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate menus or a controller test application.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A screenshot of the 'System Information' screen showing the console's serial number and online status.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen.
Video of the controller being used to navigate the system menu.
Screenshot of the 'System Information' screen showing the model and online status.
Photo of the rear ports and the bottom of the console.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Sony PlayStation 5 Slim console with a controller. It can be priced at its worst-case functional state until further proof is provided.
